scope: GPU rail plus DRAM; separate PIM compute/register energy and other system components excluded
method: DRAM energy from native counters + constant GPU average power * combined-g duration

GPU_reference.method: constant GPU average power across the entire simulated combined-g interval
GPU_reference.measurement_workload: compiled pi0.5 synthetic physical MHA8, VLM and AE on GPU in serial
GPU_reference.use_as: proxy for GPU average power in method g; this is not a VLM-only power measurement
GPU_reference.application_interval: full combined-g epoch; no additional duty factor or GPU idle term
GPU_reference.user_preference: GPU average power is sufficient for this estimate

PIM_energy_parameterization.definition: P_total = fixed_W + alpha_read * PIM_read_reference_W + alpha_write * PIM_write_reference_W

exclusions: host memory-controller/PHY energy outside the GPU rail
separate supply losses outside modeled or measured rails
assumptions: Measured serial VLM+AE GPU average is reused as a VLM/GPU power proxy; no standalone VLM GPU power has been measured in this archive.
Constant GPU power is applied throughout the full 77.677674 ms epoch, including scheduling and memory stalls.
GPU-side DRAM is already in the DRAM model; only VDD_GPU is added. Whole-system VIN is not added.
Original DRAM assumptions and device-density mismatch remain; PIM internal column energies are not vendor calibrated.
